commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "8badcdece00c876e5281afb3ca82a846859fab2c" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee'),Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')]
root=next((r for r in roots if r.exists()),None)
if root is None: raise SystemExit('ezbee headers missing')
patterns=['CUSTOM_CLUSTER','custom cluster','RAW_CMD','raw cmd','CMD_RECV','cmd recv','CMD_RECE','cmd rece','ZONE_STATUS_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION','status_change_notification','zone_status_change','zcl_cmd_hdr','cluster_id']
count=0
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.h')):
    ls=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    hits=[]
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        low=l.lower()
        if any(x.lower() in low for x in patterns): hits.append(i)
    if not hits: continue
    if not any(k in str(p).lower() for k in ['zcl_core','zcl_common','zcl_general','ias_zone','cluster']): continue
    print('===',p,'===')
    seen=[]
    for i in hits:
        lo=max(0,i-5); hi=min(len(ls),i+12)
        if any(lo>=a and hi<=b for a,b in seen): continue
        seen.append((lo,hi))
        print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
        count += 1
        if count >= 30: raise SystemExit(0)
PY
